items.title: Elvin Jones — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Ali Rakha would have been the Tabla player.

ctx.x: No. Charlie Persip had a pair and he could play ‘em. I said, “How’d you do it?” and he’s slide his thumb across it and do all this and I said, “How do you do this!” I couldn’t even—I didn’t even know where to put ‘em! I said, “You put this in-between your knees or what?” (Laughs) It was out of my league.
So you’d not seen Ravi Shankar perform? Ali Rakha would have been the Tabla player.

I had never seen any of those guys perform. They come into watch us and listen to us. I never had the chance to go to one of their concerts cause I never knew when it was going to be. Sometimes it was like they only told special people where they were going to have a concert.
